pages.title: Project detail
pages.description: Project detail contains the core information about your project. Use the filters below to show questions relevant to your project.

elements.title: Give your project a name.
Tick all the filters  that apply to your project.

choices.text: Does your project involve the collection, use, or sharing of data?
Does your project involve the use of AI or broader algorithmic tools?
Does your project interact directly with the public?
Does your project make decisions with a significant or legal effect?
Does your project work in a safety-critical area? (I.e., policing, healthcare, or working with vulnerable persons/groups)
